map.Wells 肺栓塞评分 使用指南: Wells Pulmonary Embolism Score — User Guide
map.算法（Wells PE）：评分 = 下肢 DVT 体征+既往 DVT/PE+心率: Algorithm (Wells PE): score = lower-limb DVT signs + prior DVT/PE + HR>100 + recent immobilization/surgery + alternative diagnosis less likely + hemoptysis + malignancy, seven-item sum; ≤1 low, 2–…
map.急诊分诊：疑 PE 用 Wells 分层概率: ER triage: use Wells to stratify probability when PE is suspected
map.检查决策：结合 D-二聚体定是否影像: Test decision: combine with D-dimer to decide imaging
map.Wells 高了就一定是 PE？: Does a high Wells score mean PE for sure?
map.不是，是概率分层；低度也可能 PE，需结合 D-二聚体（阴性可基本排除）与 CT: No—it is probability stratification; low probability can still be PE, so confirm with D-dimer (negative virtually excludes) and CT pulmonary angiography.
map.Wells 含临床判断（替代诊断），Geneva 纯临床变量更客观；两者都用于分: Wells includes clinical judgment (alternative diagnosis), while Geneva uses purely clinical variables and is more objective; both stratify, and results need D-dimer and imaging.
